targets.expr: {service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats count_uniq(event.id) calls

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats count_uniq(mcp.tool.name) tools

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats count_uniq(mcp.server.name) servers

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats count_uniq(event.id) if (mcp.outcome:="failed") failed, count_uniq(event.id) if (mcp.outcome:="succeeded") succeeded | math failed / (failed + succeeded) as failure_rate

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" mcp.duration_ms:* | stats quantile(0.95, mcp.duration_ms) p95_ms

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats by (mcp.outcome) count_uniq(event.id) calls

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats by (mcp.server.name, mcp.tool.name) count_uniq(event.id) calls, count_uniq(machine.id) installs, count_uniq(repo.remote) repositories | sort by (calls) desc | limit 20

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats by (mcp.server.name, mcp.tool.name) count_uniq(event.id) if (mcp.outcome:="failed") failed, count_uniq(event.id) if (mcp.outcome:="succeeded") succeeded, quantile(0.50, mcp.duration_ms) if (mcp.duration_ms:*) p50_ms, quantile(0.95, mcp.duration_ms) if (mcp.duration_ms:*) p95_ms | math failed / (failed + succeeded) as failure_rate | sort by (failure_rate) desc | limit 20

{service.name="ai-agent-telemetry"} repo.remote:~"${repository:regex}" agent:~"${harness:regex}" mcp.server.name:~"${server:regex}" mcp.tool.name:~"${tool:regex}" _msg:="mcp_tool_executed" | stats by (repo.remote, mcp.server.name, mcp.tool.name) count_uniq(event.id) calls, count_uniq(event.id) if (mcp.outcome:="failed") failed | sort by (calls) desc | limit 50

options.content: Failure rate uses failed / (succeeded + failed); unknown outcomes are excluded. Latency panels use only events that contain duration. Empty denominators are shown as no data.
